rows.en: So it's begun...!! Regis... This whole space is collapsing!!
It's dangerous here!! Let's head back to base!!
The heroes boarded the Ride Machine and made straight for the base.
"The Minus Energy readings all around are gradually disappearing...!!"
"The tremors have started here too! It looks like the base is going to collapse as well...!!"
"What is this...!? My body... It's fading away!?"
Your original worlds are trying to call you back.
Yes. The original worlds have been trying to pull the power of justice back all along.
Now that Regis is gone, the force that bound you to this side has vanished.
It seems the timing differs from person to person.
"...Huh? Then I have to say goodbye just like this!?"
Hey, hey!! Dammit!! We fought side by side, didn't we!!
No way...!! But we fought side by side!!
Let's hurry!! Ride Machine, full speed ahead!!!

notes.note: Speakers verified against 0736.bla (MessWinSet TextIdOffset+N plays #N+1): #448-449 Seravee's Voice (+447/+448). The source breaks off after 'Regis...'; kept as a fragment rather than guessing the missing predicate.

#450-464 = TextIdOffset+449+R2, chain at 3225: Ultraman, Rider 1, Nu, Seven, Black RX, Zeta, Taro, Den-O Sword (#457 rough 'You got it!!'), God Gundam, Mebius (#459 polite 'Yes!!'), W, Wing Zero (#461 'Roger!!'), Zero, OOO, 00. Identical lines kept identical. The extracted '?party' label on #450 is right; the 00 name before the call is a placeholder.
#469 and #471 are never played by the script (Zoffy's +467 and +469 run back to back). Translated as a generic party reply; 'it' in the source read as Regis.
Zoffy over comms from base; 'all around' = around the party/area.
Hikari: his body is fading too (reply to Methuss).
Seravee's Voice explains to Methuss/Hikari; 'you' restored for the people being pulled back.
Binding force read as acting on the heroes ('you'), which the source leaves unstated.
Methuss: 'this is goodbye just like this' = vanishing before the party gets back; the party's protest in #493+ answers it.

#493-522 = TextIdOffset+492+R2 / +493+R2 with R2 stepping by 2, chain at 5105: Den-O Sword (#493-494), Zeta (#495-496), Mebius (#497-498), W (#499-500), OOO (#501-502), Zero (#503-504), Black RX (#505-506), God Gundam (#507-508), Rider 1 (#509-510), Nu (#511-512), Taro (#513-514), Seven (#515-516), Ultraman (#517-518), 00 (#519-520), Wing Zero (#521, its second line #522 is in story_178). The Wing Zero name before the call is a placeholder. 'We fought side by side' = protest that she can't leave without a proper farewell.
Zeta/Nu: 'Methuss!' read as calling out to her over comms while telling the team they are rushing back; the source could also be addressed to the team only.
00 / Wing Zero: same ambiguity, kept as 'Methuss... Let's hurry back!' (volitional).
Strong-enemy warning prompts (0803/0804/0805/0890/0891 identical). No speaker; system text addressed to the player as 'you'. No earlier English precedent found for these prompts.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0736.bla: #450-464 use the chain at 3225, #493-522 the chain at 5105 (step 2, pairs). #469/#471 unused by the script. #448 trailing fragment kept. No new names or terms.
